speaker: charlie
text: Right, science time, and I promise to try and keep up, Jamie. Aussie researchers have been chipping away at some genuinely clever marine and medical science, the kind of work that quietly makes life better without ever making the front page.

speaker: alice
text: That's the thing about good science, it rarely comes with fireworks, it comes with years of patient lab work and then suddenly a breakthrough that helps protect the reef or improve someone's health. Slow and steady really does win the race sometimes.

speaker: charlie
text: Feels like half of Australia's best scientists are quietly beavering away in labs right now while we're all worrying about footy tipping. Good on them, someone's got to keep the smart people employed.
